capabilities: Create a table of contents at the top of a file or at the cursor
Automatically update the table of contents after heading changes
Choose arrow or bullet markers and a default title
Exclude code-block comment lines that look like headings
Strip formatting characters such as italics markers from titles
disambiguation: Its distinguishing feature is Publish compatibility, not general TOC generation; it inserts a Markdown TOC into the note rather than rendering one in the UI.
extras: A 'Style Choices' section says 'Create the gifs for altering choices' but no gifs are included; some advertised sections (e.g. style gifs) appear unfinished.
intentEvidence: Creates a table of contents that is compatible with publish i.e. that if the page is pushed to publish the table of contents will still be there.
problem: Table-of-contents generation in Obsidian can produce output that does not survive publishing, so notes pushed to Publish lose their TOC.

relations.evidence: Table of contents plugin that will be compatible with Publish.

summary: Generates a Markdown table of contents in a note that stays intact when the note is published with Obsidian Publish.
